exposure: different types of pelvic fractures (anteroposterior compression, acetabular, combined, lateral compression, vertical shear)
Women with different types of pelvic fractures
outcome: sexual dysfunction (dyspareunia, coital incontinence, anorgasmia, reduced frequency of intercourse)
cohort: 91 women of reproductive age with pelvic ring fractures
finding: The frequency of pelvic floor dysfunction and sexual problems was higher in women with vertical shear and combined pelvic fractures.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 33% among women who gave birth after experiencing a pelvic fracture.
